summary.headline: Astronomical Chapters and Eclipse Tables
summary.text: Florentine codex catalogue entries on inhabited-world tables, luminary epochs, conjunctions and full moons, eclipses, ecliptic nodes, lunar latitude, lunar epochs, wandering-star tables, oracles, ephemerides, and solar calculation, citing Panaetius, Eudorus, and Claudius Ptolemy. A marginal note records solar and lunar eclipses in 1376 and 1387.
